title: Flow identity
subtitle: Silver and Gold transformation step. dataflow_id is a dependency label only.

fields.label: flow_step_id
fields.description: Unique ID for this transformation step.

fields.label: dataflow_id
fields.description: Which ingestion flow this logically follows.

title: Target dataset
subtitle: Where this transformation step lands in Unity Catalog.

fields.label: target_catalog
fields.description: Unity Catalog catalog for the target table.

title: Source inputs
subtitle: Upstream tables. input_name must be unique across the entire spec and is what transformation_sql joins on.

fields.label: source_inputs[]
fields.description: Upstream tables or views consumed by this transformation.

fields.label: input_name
fields.description: Must be unique across entire spec. Referenced in transformation_sql FROM/JOIN.

fields.label: is_streaming
fields.description: true reads with spark.readStream.table, false with spark.read.table.

fields.label: watermark.event_time_column
fields.description: Event-time column for watermarking. Required when streaming and joined with another stream.

fields.label: watermark.delay_threshold
fields.description: Maximum allowed event lateness. Required when streaming and joined with another stream.

title: Decrypted columns
subtitle: The only valid place to decrypt — never in target_config. Runs before transformation_sql.

fields.label: source_inputs[].decrypted_columns[]
fields.description: Columns to decrypt on input before running transformation SQL.

fields.label: applies to input_name
fields.description: Which source_inputs[] entry this decryption belongs to.

fields.label: column_name
fields.description: Source ciphertext column on the input table.

fields.label: output_column
fields.description: Output plaintext column. Use different name to keep both ciphertext and plaintext.

fields.label: mode
fields.description: Must match mode column was encrypted with.

fields.label: cast_to_type
fields.description: Spark SQL type to cast decrypted value to. Cross-validated against original_data_type tag.

title: Transformation SQL
subtitle: Native Spark SQL query defining the transformation logic.

fields.label: transformation_sql
fields.placeholder: SELECT example_id, region, amount FROM example_raw_input WHERE amount > ${min_amount}
fields.description: The SQL transform query. Reads from input_name values declared in source_inputs.
